interpretation: requirements = documents the page asks for when the visa is filed (including the page's special requirements); checklist = what the page asks after entry. Items are the page's own wording (id) with a faithful English rendering (en); page_quote is a verbatim fragment of the saved page text. Vendor-only items (health insurance, domestic helper) are deliberately absent. The catalogue lists documents only and adds no eligibility gate. Every product not listed here keeps UNKNOWN / DOCUMENTATION_CATALOG_NOT_VERIFIED.

requirements.en: Commitment statement (Surat Pernyataan Komitmen) as the Immigration Guarantee: to place at least USD 130,000 (or the equivalent) in an own-name account at a state-owned bank

checklist.en: Within 90 days of entry, report to the immigration office that issued the stay permit, with proof of at least USD 130,000 (or the equivalent) in an own-name account at a state-owned bank

checklist.en: Or, instead, proof of ownership of an apartment (rumah susun) in Indonesia worth at least USD 1,000,000 (or the equivalent), reported within the same 90 days
checklist.id: Atau, sebagai gantinya, bukti kepemilikan properti berupa rumah susun atau apartemen di Indonesia senilai paling sedikit US$1.000.000 atau setara, dilaporkan dalam 90 hari yang sama
checklist.page_quote: Bukti kepemilihan properti berupa rumah susun atau apartemen di Indonesia senilai paling sedikit US$1.000.000
